description: HAL LegalAI Gateway Phase 2 service/tool registry. Maps stable namespaced gateway tools to independently deployable downstream MCP services.

bridge.notes: Case-facing MCP tools and proof workflow dispatch. Remains separately deployable. Direct clients use GitHub OAuth on /mcp; Gateway calls the service-only /mcp/service TokenVerifier path with BRIDGE_SERVICE_TOKEN via GATEWAY_BRIDGE_AUTHORIZATION (never a copied user OAuth bearer).

storage.notes: Storage inventory/archive surface. URL defaults to the bridge today but is independently configurable so storage can be split without gateway code changes.

mission_control.notes: Must point at the Mission Control MCP Streamable HTTP base (SERVICE_MODE=mcp). MCP tools use server-side MISSION_CONTROL_API_KEY; gateway write access is gated by inbound GitHub OAuth.

artifacts.notes: Artifact retrieval surface. Independently configurable from case/storage so retrieval can move without disabling unrelated namespaces.

case.description: LegalAI case workflow tools (question-agnostic Case-00 and Q1-specific).

storage.description: Bounded Case-00 storage inventory and archive tools.

mission.description: Mission Control run submission and observation tools.

workflow.description: Mission Control durable workflow submit, sanitized status, and cancel tools.

tool_routes.notes: Proof artifact copy/verify path; routed to the artifact retrieval downstream.
Allowlisted case artifact read; independently health-checked via artifacts service.

tool_bindings.description: Read-only resolver for nhpcorp35/legal-ai commits. Accepts ref exactly main or a lowercase 40-character SHA. Returns immutable commit_sha; rejects repository, URL, path, and owner input.
tool_bindings.notes: Gateway-native read-only resolver; does not forward downstream.

tool_bindings.description: Dispatch a question-agnostic Case-00 run. Requires benchmark_id, question_id, authorization_confirmed, and an exact lowercase 40-character commit_sha (mutable refs rejected).
Return the current GitHub status for a Case-00 mission_id.
Cancel the Case-00 GitHub Actions run for mission_id.
List and HEAD-verify durable Case-00 B2 objects for mission_id.

Archive and HEAD-verify one LegalAI acceptance_contract.v1 JSON object. Preferred input is structured contract (template example pass-through). Server serializes, hashes, and generates the canonical object key; legacy base64 inputs remain optional.
tool_bindings.notes: Preferred MCP field: contract (structured JSON). Server-side canonical UTF-8 serialization, contract_sha256 (excludes content_sha256), object key, and object_sha256. No client Base64/Web Crypto/hash required. Legacy contract_json_base64 + expected identity/digest optional. Returns object_key, size, contract_sha256, object_sha256, verified.

tool_bindings.description: Independently HEAD-verify one acceptance-contract object by key, size, contract_sha256, and object_sha256.
tool_bindings.notes: Safe metadata only; never returns contract contents or criterion prose.

tool_bindings.description: List object metadata under the canonical acceptance-contracts B2 prefix for acceptance_contract.v1 archives.
Read-only acceptance_contract.v1 nested-identity JSON Schema, canonical hashing rules, and one synthetic non-private example.
tool_bindings.notes: No B2 writes. Example uses generic synthetic IDs only and can be passed directly as archive_acceptance_contract(contract=example).

tool_bindings.description: Fetch and verify one acceptance_contract.v1 JSON object from canonical legalai-corpus B2 using bounded identity fields only.
tool_bindings.notes: Inputs: benchmark_id, question_id, contract_id, version. Server generates canonical key. Fail-closed on schema/identity/size/hash mismatch. Returns safe metadata plus structured contract. Never accepts arbitrary keys/URLs/paths. Does not log contract bodies or credentials.
Closest truthful inventory verification mapping (no separate verify_archive downstream tool).

tool_bindings.description: List bounded, redacted Phase 2C durable notifications for a Mission Control run_id. Optional limit is safely clamped. Returns only allowlisted inspection fields; never webhook URL/secret, claim owner, raw request headers/body, or sensitive error contents. Does not mutate runs or change mission.wait/cursor.

Wait for a Mission Control run to reach a terminal status (completed, failed, timed_out, or cancelled) or timeout_seconds. Forwards Phase 2B monitoring fields (heartbeat_health, stale_heartbeat, monitoring_history, cursor, stale_threshold_seconds) unchanged from Mission Control. Optional cursor resumes bounded history after wait_expired; omit for legacy callers. Wait expiry never mutates or cancels the run.

Submit exact mission YAML and wait for a terminal run state. Returns Phase 2B monitoring fields from Mission Control. When wait_expired is true, resume with mission.wait using the same run_id and returned cursor.

Submit bounded workflow YAML to Mission Control (downstream submit_workflow). Accepts workflow_yaml and optional idempotency_key and returns the downstream structured envelope. Orchestration remains fail-closed while MISSION_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_ORCHESTRATION is disabled. Thin forwarder: no YAML parsing, polling, or feature enabling in the gateway.

Return sanitized durable workflow and child summaries for a canonical workflow_id (downstream get_workflow). Secrets, child mission YAML, and agent stdout/stderr are never included. Orchestration remains fail-closed while MISSION_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_ORCHESTRATION is disabled. Thin forwarder: no polling, cancel, history, or workflow parsing in the gateway.

Cancel a durable Mission Control workflow (downstream cancel_workflow). Returns the sanitized durable status envelope. Secrets, child mission YAML, and agent stdout/stderr are never included. Orchestration remains fail-closed while MISSION_CONTROL_WORKFLOW_ORCHESTRATION is disabled. Thin forwarder: no polling, history, or workflow parsing in the gateway.
